description: API dependency graph for airline domain based on manual analysis of actual workflow dependencies

nodes.description: Get the details of a user, including their reservations.
nodes.workflow_role: User information retrieval - provides reservation_ids and payment_method_ids

nodes.description: Returns a list of all available airports with IATA codes and city names.
nodes.workflow_role: Airport discovery - maps city names to IATA codes

nodes.description: Search for direct flights between two cities on a specific date.
nodes.workflow_role: Flight search - provides available flight numbers, times, prices, and seat availability

nodes.description: Search for one-stop flights between two cities on a specific date.
nodes.workflow_role: Flight search - provides pairs of connecting flights with details

nodes.description: Get the status of a flight (available, delayed, on time, flying).
nodes.workflow_role: Flight status check - verifies if flight is bookable or has issues

nodes.description: Get the details of a reservation.
nodes.workflow_role: Reservation information retrieval - provides flights, passengers, payments, status

nodes.description: Book a new flight reservation with flights, passengers, and payment.
nodes.workflow_role: Reservation creation - requires flight info from search, payment_method_ids from user

nodes.description: Cancel the whole reservation and process refunds.
nodes.workflow_role: Reservation cancellation - requires reservation_id and must verify cancellation policy

nodes.description: Update the flight information of a reservation including cabin change.
nodes.workflow_role: Reservation modification - requires reservation_id, new flight info from search, payment_method_id

nodes.description: Update the baggage information of a reservation.
nodes.workflow_role: Reservation modification - requires reservation_id and payment_method_id for additional baggage fees

nodes.description: Update the passenger information of a reservation (same number of passengers).
nodes.workflow_role: Reservation modification - requires reservation_id, number of passengers must match

nodes.description: Send a travel certificate to a user as compensation.
nodes.workflow_role: Compensation - requires user_id, adds certificate to user's payment methods

nodes.description: Calculate the result of a mathematical expression.
nodes.workflow_role: Utility - standalone, helps with price calculations

nodes.description: Transfer the user to a human agent.
nodes.workflow_role: Escalation - standalone, called when agent cannot handle request

User object contains payment_methods for paying additional baggage fees
After verifying user details, can send certificate as compensation

Airport list provides IATA codes needed for one-stop flight searches
Search results provide flight_number, date, prices, and availability needed to construct FlightInfo objects for booking
One-stop search results provide connecting flight details needed for booking multi-leg trips
Search results provide new flight options when modifying existing reservation
One-stop search provides alternative flight options for reservation modifications
Search results provide flight_number and date that can be used to check detailed status
One-stop search provides flight details that can be used to verify status of each segment
Get reservation to verify cancellation eligibility, then use reservation_id to cancel
Get reservation to see current flights and verify modification rules before updating
Get reservation to see current baggage count before updating
Get reservation to see current passengers before updating their information

Reservation contains flights with flight_number and date that can be checked for delays/cancellations

policy_constraints.description: Flight can be cancelled only if: booked within 24 hrs, flight cancelled by airline, business class, or has insurance covering reason. Cannot cancel if any portion has been flown.
Only compensate silver/gold members or business/insured passengers. $100 per passenger for cancelled flights, $50 per passenger for delayed flights. Do not proactively offer.

metadata.analysis_method: Manual analysis based on domain logic and workflow understanding
key_insights: get_user_details is a central hub providing user_id, reservation_ids, and payment_method_ids
Flight search APIs (search_direct_flight, search_onestop_flight) feed into booking and modification
get_reservation_details is required before any reservation modification to verify eligibility
Policy enforcement happens in application logic, not in API - agent must verify rules
Compensation flow requires checking multiple sources: user membership, reservation cabin, flight status
